title: feat(plugin-dashboard): a widget's `component` envelope draws a `metric-card` and nothing else (objectui#12254)
body:
Fixes #12254
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Both dashboard surfaces now draw a widget's legacy `component` envelope by the rule the authoring faces have stated since objectui#12163: a `metric-card` node draws as before, and any other node draws the existing retired-format placeholder and sends no query. This executes the follow-on that ruling C on objectui#12163 named (`6121298298`, taken with letter A, `6125043394`), as triage `6125692023` directs: a read-only census first, then, on a count of 0, the retirement.

## Census of stored use (read-only)

The census reads metadata as stored, and source. Each store is read structurally: a TypeScript-AST and JSON/YAML walker visits every `widgets` array element that carries `component`, every `component: { type … }` object literal anywhere, and every `type: 'custom'`. A control count of `widgets` arrays reached is given for each store, so a 0 is a reading and not a walk that found nothing.

| Store | What was read | Non-`metric-card` envelope nodes outside tests and docs |
|---|---|---|
| objectui: `examples/`, `apps/`, templates, fixtures | `origin/main` `0cd322d7`, 7655 json/yaml/js/ts files (the 87 unparsed are JSONC `tsconfig` files) | **0**. Control: 212 `widgets` arrays in 125 files reached, the 9 `examples/schema-catalog` dashboards among them. Every envelope hit is a test in `packages/types` or `packages/plugin-dashboard`. |
| objectstack: `examples/`, templates, seeds | `origin/main` `e49aaec7`, 9494 files | **0**. Control: 177 `widgets` arrays in 76 files, among them the `app-crm`, `app-showcase` (3) and `app-todo` dashboards and `platform-objects`' `system_overview`. |
| objectstack-ai/hotcrm dashboards | depth-1 read-only clone at `0f84c9c7`, 570 files, nothing executed | **0**. Control: 5 dashboards, 62 widget entries; the shared widget factories return `funnel` and `metric` widgets with no `component`. |
| cloud: seeded and marketplace packages | **UNREAD.** `git clone --depth 1` answered "could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled"; the REST read answered 403 "GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session". | **UNREAD, not 0.** |
| The dashboard designers | writer code at `0cd322d7`: `plugin-designer`'s `DashboardEditor`; Studio's `DashboardDefaultInspector`, `DashboardWidgetInspector` and `DashboardPreview` | **0.** No writer emits `component`, and no type picker offers `custom`. They write `id`, `title`, `type`, `layout`, `colorVariant`, `dataset`, `dimensions`, `values` and `filterBindings`; an update spreads `{ ...w, ...updates }`, which carries a stored key through and never authors one. |
| Studio's raw JSON source view | the save door, objectstack `origin/main` `e49aaec7` | Cannot store a `component` key at all: `saveMetaItem` validates against `@objectstack/spec`'s `DashboardSchema`, whose widget is a `strictObject` that refuses `component` by name (`QUARANTINED_WIDGET_KEYS`, pinned by the spec's `dashboard.test.ts` "quarantine branch"). |
| Stored databases on this container | `find` for `*.db` / `*.sqlite*` outside `node_modules` | none present |

An inference, not a read: a cloud package loaded through `defineStack` or saved through `saveMetaItem` is parsed by the same strict spec widget, which refuses a `component` key whatever node it holds. That bounds the unread store; it does not count it.

## What changes

- **`isRetiredEnvelopeNode`** (`legacyRetiredWidget.ts`), the one predicate both surfaces read, now answers true for every envelope node but a `metric-card`: a node whose `type` is not a member of `DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES` (the closed list the zod faces route on), a node with no `type`, a string or a number. It used to name `object-metric` alone (objectui#11466), which is now one case of the rule. An empty envelope still holds no node and draws by its family.
- **`DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout`**: the envelope branch hands the renderer `toDashboardNodeType(node)`, only ever a `metric-card` now. The `toRenderableSchema` bridge for a primitive is gone from both, since a primitive in the envelope now draws the placeholder.
- **Made false by this change, so repaired in it:** `DashboardRenderer` drew a `custom` widget with no `component` as a prompt to "set `component` to a UIComponent schema". A UIComponent other than a `metric-card` now draws the retired placeholder, so the prompt sent authors to a dead end. That widget now draws `unsupportedWidgetSchema('custom')`, which `DashboardGridLayout` already drew for it. No placeholder, prop, export, spec key or i18n key is added; one bespoke placeholder is removed.
- The filter broadcast's doc comment drops the envelope's `object-chart` and `object-data-table`, which no longer draw there. The `custom` dispatch family's doc says what it draws now.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` and the package README state the draw rule where they stated that the surfaces still drew any stored node.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` `minor`, BREAKING stated in prose with FROM and TO examples.

`@object-ui/types` and the zod faces are not touched.

## Pins

New: `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/envelopeDrawRetired-12254.test.tsx`, run on both surfaces:

- **The retired draw.** Nine envelope inputs: a `custom` widget's `text`, `object-chart` (with the filter bar set), `object-data-table`, `card`, a node with no `type`, the namespaced `plugin-dashboard:metric-card` node key, a string, a number and `true`. Each draws `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA` by identity, puts nothing of the node on screen and sends no `find`, `aggregate` or `queryDataset`. Each is also refused at `component` by the zod face, so the draw and authoring agree.
- A typeless envelope (holding an `object-chart`, a number, or `true`) keeps its card heading around the placeholder.
- A `custom` widget with no `component` draws `unsupportedWidgetSchema('custom')`.
- **CONTROL:** a `metric-card` envelope (typeless, and in a `custom` widget) draws its figure under the namespaced node key, exactly `{ ...card, type: 'plugin-dashboard:metric-card' }`, and the zod face accepts it.
- **Unchanged:** the `object-metric` envelope pin objectui#11466 wrote (`inlineObjectMetricRetired-11525.test.tsx`), and both surfaces' `legacyRetired` suites.

Fixture triage, by what each fixture pinned:

- `inlineObjectMetricRetired-11525.test.tsx`: its last block pinned that the filter bar still scoped an envelope's `object-chart` and `object-data-table`, which is the branch this change removes. The block is replaced by the new file's cases, and a dated note explains the change.
- `dashboard-producer-node-types-11514.test.tsx`: section 3 pinned the `toRenderableSchema` bridge for a primitive in the envelope, which this change removes. It is replaced the same way.
- `nodeSlotDeclaration-11170.test.tsx`: it used a `text` node only as a probe of the `widgets[].component` node slot. It is re-spelled to a `metric-card` carrying the mark. The slot declaration stays true, because the renderer still hands the slot's node to `SchemaRenderer`.

### Reverse verification

Both legs ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode) from committed `dd076421`. The expected direction was stated before each run, in the new file's header.

- **Leg 1, the old predicate planted back** (`object-metric` only): `Tests 24 failed | 38 passed (62)`. Every retired-draw case and every heading case is red on both surfaces. The four CONTROLs, both `custom`-no-component cases and the whole 11525 file are green. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob from `fd792f2d` to `e3670325`. On restore, the blob is again `fd792f2d`, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Leg 2, the old `custom` prompt planted back:** `Tests 1 failed | 29 passed (30)`. The red one is the renderer's `custom`-no-component case; the grid never had that branch. The blob went from `3a7628c5` to `74db5575`, and on restore it equals HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

The tests import the subject by relative source path, so no `dist/` is involved.

## Verification at `dd076421`

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/`: `Test Files 175 passed (175)`, `Tests 1749 passed | 6 skipped (1755)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. The test program lists all four touched test files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard lint` (`eslint .`): exit 0, 0 errors.
- Exit 0, run after the scoped doc-gate build the gates name: `check:doc-snippets` (788 of 788 blocks judged, 0 failed), `check:doc-examples`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`, `docs:check-links`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids` and `check:doc-example-readers`.
- Exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the diff: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure`. Reason: it reads `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, a console build this run did not make. The diff adds no import that is not already in the package's closure.

A contract-tier review is owed before the queue: this narrows what the published renderer draws, as the claim records.

## Acceptance notes

- `custom` stays in objectui's widget vocabulary (`DASHBOARD_WIDGET_TYPE_EXTENSIONS`). After this change a `custom` widget draws a `metric-card` envelope or a placeholder, nothing else. Whether the `custom` type itself retires is the D question's other half, and it was not measured here. Carrier: none.
- `unsupportedWidgetSchema`'s wording, "chart type is not supported yet", now also covers `custom`, which is not a chart family. That is existing wording; this change does not touch it. Carrier: none.
